summary: Ketu's own sub-period at the start of its dasha (about 4 months 27 days) is described by most texts as a strained time: worry over spouse and children, quarrels, fever, loss of money and separation from relatives. BPHS makes it good, with family happiness, official recognition and gains of land (though still with mental unease), when Ketu is in a kendra or trikona or linked with the lagna lord or the 9th, 10th or 4th lord.
themes: land and recognition when well placed
common_outcomes: fear for the wife and children, loss of happiness and wealth, trouble from enemies (Jataka Parijata 18.146)
quarrels with enemies, friction with friends, harsh words, burning fever, intrusion into others' homes, loss of wealth (Phaladeepika 21.66)
fear for wife or children, loss of wealth and happiness, mental trouble, separation from relatives, some restraint or detention, danger of poison (Raman, p. 271)
rare_outcomes: recognition from the ruler and gains of land and villages (BPHS 59.1-2, when well placed)
[maraka: Jataka Parijata 18.146 and Raman p. 271 speak of the death of wife and children]

by_area.personality: Mental agony even in the good case (BPHS 59.1-2); instability of mind when badly placed (BPHS 59.3-4); mental trouble (Raman).
by_area.career: Recognition from the ruler when well placed (BPHS 59.1-2); defamation when badly placed (BPHS 59.3-4); favours from superiors (Rele p. 99).
by_area.finance: Gains of land and villages when well placed (BPHS 59.1-2); loss of wealth and cattle (BPHS 59.3-4; Phaladeepika 21.66; Jataka Parijata 18.146).
by_area.health: Heart disease (BPHS 59.3-4; Rele); fever (Phaladeepika 21.66); danger of poison (Raman); disease when Ketu is in or linked to the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 59.5-6).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from wife and children when well placed (BPHS 59.1-2); distress to wife and children otherwise (BPHS 59.3-4; Jataka Parijata 18.146; Raman).
by_area.family: Separation from kinsmen (BPHS 59.5-6; Raman); loss of a brother when Ketu is in the 2nd or 7th (Rele p. 99).

strengtheners: Ketu in a kendra or trikona from the lagna (BPHS 59.1)
Ketu joined with the lagna lord, or related to the 9th, 10th or 4th lord (BPHS 59.1; the 4th is clear in the Sanskrit gloss)
Rele: aspected by the 9th or 10th lord
weakeners_or_cancellations: Ketu in its debilitation sign in the 8th or 12th with a combust planet (BPHS 59.3-4, Santhanam)
Ketu in or linked with the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 59.5-6)
Ketu with malefics (Rele p. 99)
lagna_or_context_notes: In its own sub-period Ketu is both lords, so the position from the dasha lord is always the 1st; BPHS judges this sub-period only from the lagna. The library's node dignity (debilitated Scorpio) is the reverse of BPHS 47.35, which exalts Ketu in Scorpio, so the debilitation condition is left manual. Narasimha Rao (ch. 16) judges antardashas mainly from the Moon, and allows the dasha lord as a temporary lagna.

source_views.source: BPHS 59.1-6, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Ketu in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, or with the lagna lord, or related to the 9th and 10th lords: happiness from wife and children, recognition from the ruler but mental agony, gains of land and villages. In debilitation and in the 8th or 12th with a combust planet: heart disease, defamation, loss of wealth and cattle, distress to wife and children, unstable mind. Related to the 2nd or 7th lords or placed in the 2nd or 7th: disease, great distress, separation from kin. Remedy: Durga Saptashati and Mrityunjaya japa.

source_views.source: BPHS 59.1-6, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com
source_views.view: Verse 1 adds the 4th lord to the 9th and 10th and the 11th house to kendra and trikona. Verse 3 reads the bad case as Ketu with a debilitated or combust planet, or in the 8th or 12th, as alternatives. Remedy: japa to Durga and the Mrityunjaya mantra.

In debility or with malefics: heart trouble, loss of credit, trouble to wife and children, loss of property. In the 2nd or 7th: disease, trouble, loss of a brother.

source_views.view: General rule only: judge an antardasa from the Moon; the dasha lord may be taken as a temporary lagna.

disagreements: BPHS allows a good version; Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman give only troubles. Santhanam requires debilitation, the 8th/12th and a combust planet together, while the Sanskrit gloss treats them as alternatives. Rele's printed list of good houses includes the 8th, which no other source does and which BPHS treats as bad.
phrasing_guidance: Present this short opening phase as one that calls for patience with family and money matters; mention the favourable version only when the chart shows the listed placements. Do not predict the death of spouse or children; at most advise extra care for family health.

effects: recognition from the ruler, though with mental agony

summary: Venus's sub-period in Ketu's dasha (about 1 year 2 months) splits the sources: BPHS and Raman see wealth, vehicles, recovery of lost position, a child and pilgrimage when Venus is strong, while Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman's later months stress discord with spouse and relatives, illness in the family, fever and humiliation. BPHS reverses it when Venus is 6th, 8th or 12th from Ketu, debilitated, or in the 6th or 8th from the lagna.
common_outcomes: illness of wife and children, quarrels, loss of relatives and friends, fever and dysentery (Jataka Parijata 18.147)
conflict with a learned Brahmin, discord with spouse and kin, birth of a daughter, humiliation, worry for others (Phaladeepika 21.67)
wealth and happiness, birth of a child, success in efforts; at the end sickness, the wife and children ill, quarrels, fever and dysentery (Raman, p. 272)
rare_outcomes: recovery of a lost kingdom or reinstatement in high office (BPHS 59.7-9)
bathing at Setu and a vision of deities (BPHS 59.9, Sanskrit gloss)

by_area.personality: Mental agony when Venus is a 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 59.15).
by_area.career: Favour from the ruler, reinstatement in a high position, and dawn of fortune with a 9th-10th lord link (BPHS 59.7-9); loss of honour (Rele p. 100; BPHS 59.13-14).
by_area.finance: Gains of clothes, vehicles, land and villages (BPHS 59.7-9); good food and vehicles (BPHS 59.10-11); causeless quarrels, loss of wealth and cattle when Venus is 6th, 8th or 12th from Ketu (BPHS 59.12).
by_area.health: Headache, eye trouble, heart disease (BPHS 59.13-14; Rele); fever and dysentery (Jataka Parijata 18.147; Raman).
by_area.relationships: Discord with the spouse (Phaladeepika 21.67); illness of the wife (Jataka Parijata 18.147; Raman); marriage (Rele p. 100); distress to the wife when Venus is afflicted (BPHS 59.13-14).
by_area.family: Birth of a child (Raman) or of a daughter (Phaladeepika 21.67); quarrels with kinsmen (BPHS 59.13-14); loss of relatives and friends (Jataka Parijata 18.147).
by_area.spirituality: Visits to sacred shrines (BPHS 59.9); religious tendencies and pilgrimage (Rele p. 100).

strengtheners: Venus exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 59.7)
Venus with the 10th lord in a kendra or trikona, and also with the 9th lord (BPHS 59.7-9)
Venus in a kendra, trikona, the 3rd or 11th from Ketu (BPHS 59.10-11)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Venus 6th, 8th or 12th from Ketu (BPHS 59.12)
Venus debilitated or with a debilitated planet, or in the 6th or 8th from the lagna (BPHS 59.13-14)
Venus as lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 59.15)
lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS uses both references here: the 3rd/11th/kendra/trikona and 6th/8th/12th rules are counted from Ketu (the dasha lord), the 6th/8th rule from the lagna. Rele counts his conditions from the lagna or the dasha lord ('significator').

source_views.source: BPHS 59.7-15, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Venus exalted or in own sign, or with the 10th lord in a kendra or trikona: favour from the ruler, clothes, recovery of lost position, vehicles, pilgrimage, land and villages; with the 9th lord too, dawn of fortune. In a kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th from Ketu: health, family well-being, good food and vehicles. In the 6th, 8th or 12th from Ketu: causeless quarrels, loss of wealth, distress to cattle. Debilitated, with a debilitated planet, or 6th or 8th from the lagna: quarrels with kin, headache, eye trouble, heart disease, defamation, losses, distress to wife and cattle. As 2nd or 7th lord: physical and mental distress. Remedy: Durga path and gift of a tawny cow or female buffalo.

source_views.source: BPHS 59.7-15, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com
source_views.view: Adds bathing at Setu and a vision of deities. The gloss's verse 12 lists the 6th, 7th, 8th or 12th with malefics (the page notes its Sanskrit and English differ). Remedy: Durga japa and gift of a cow and buffalo.

source_views.view: Venus exalted, in own sign, with the 9th or 10th lord, or in a kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th from the lagna or dasha lord: unexpected gains, favours, marriage, property, religion and pilgrimage. Debilitated or with a malefic in the 6th, 8th or 12th: eye and head trouble, injury, loss of honour, trouble to wife and children.

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, Crux of Vedic Astrology pp. 78, 117
source_views.view: Examples only: a death timed in Ketu dasa Venus sub-period for a long-lived native with Ketu in the badhaka house and Venus in the 7th (p. 78); twins born in Ketu-Venus with Venus as 3rd lord from the arudha lagna (p. 117).

disagreements: BPHS and Rele give a strongly good version under conditions; Phaladeepika and Jataka Parijata give mainly family discord and illness; Raman combines both, good first and bad at the end. The Sanskrit gloss of verse 12 lists the 6th, 7th, 8th and 12th with malefics, Santhanam the 6th, 8th and 12th from Ketu. Remedy cow: tawny (Santhanam) vs white (gloss).
phrasing_guidance: Describe a period that can bring comfort, gains and a family event, with a need to look after relations with the spouse and relatives and family health. Avoid predicting a death; Rath's example is not a rule.

effects: good fortune and gain of clothes

summary: The Sun's short sub-period in Ketu's dasha (about 4 months 6 days) is mostly hard in the general texts: disappointment, physical pain, being away from home, obstacles, fever and rifts with relatives or elders. BPHS makes it good, with wealth, official favour, a son and pious works, when the Sun is exalted, in its own sign, with benefics, or in a kendra, trikona, 2nd or 11th from Ketu, and adds a maraka warning when the Sun rules the 2nd or 7th.
common_outcomes: disappointment, physical pain, exile in a foreign land, danger and obstruction in every business (Jataka Parijata 18.148)
death of a respected elder, fever, rifts with relatives, gains from foreign travel, service to the king against a rebellion, phlegm and wind disorders (Phaladeepika 21.68)
disappointment, pain, exile, obstacles; increase of knowledge, sickness in the family, a long journey and return, worry about the wife's health (Raman, p. 272)
rare_outcomes: headship of a small village (BPHS 59.20-21)
[maraka: BPHS 59.22-24 predicts fear of premature death when the Sun rules the 2nd or 7th]

by_area.career: Favour of the ruler and fulfilment of ambitions when well placed (BPHS 59.16-17); danger and punishment from government when the Sun is with malefics in the 8th or 12th (BPHS 59.18-19); quarrels with superiors (Rele p. 100).
by_area.finance: Gains of wealth (BPHS 59.16-17, 20-21); loss of wealth and cattle and trouble getting food when the Sun is with malefics 8th or 12th from Ketu (BPHS 59.22-24).
by_area.health: Fever (BPHS 59.18-19; Phaladeepika 21.68); physical pain (Jataka Parijata 18.148); physical fitness when well placed (BPHS 59.20-21); serious illness if in the 2nd or 7th (Rele).
by_area.family: Separation from parents (BPHS 59.18-19); death of an elder (Phaladeepika 21.68); birth of a son (BPHS 59.20-21; Rele).

strengtheners: Sun exalted or in own sign, or with or aspected by benefics in a kendra or trikona (BPHS 59.16-17)
Sun in a kendra, trikona, 2nd or 11th from Ketu (BPHS 59.20-21)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Sun with malefics in the 8th or 12th from the lagna (BPHS 59.18-19)
Sun with malefics in the 8th or 12th from Ketu (BPHS 59.22-24)
Sun as lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 59.24)
lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS gives separate rules from the lagna (59.18-19) and from Ketu (59.20-24); keep them distinct.

source_views.source: BPHS 59.16-24, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Sun exalted, in own sign, or with or aspected by benefics in a kendra or trikona: wealth, royal favour, pious deeds, fulfilment of ambitions. With malefics in the 8th or 12th from the lagna: danger from government, separation from parents, foreign journeys, thieves, snakes and poison, punishment, quarrels with friends, sorrow, fever. In a kendra, trikona, 2nd or 11th from Ketu: fitness, wealth, a son, pious deeds, headship of a small village. With evil planets 8th or 12th from Ketu: trouble getting food, fear, loss of wealth and cattle; distress at the start, some relief at the end; fear of premature death if the Sun is 2nd or 7th lord. Remedy: gift of a cow and gold.

source_views.source: BPHS 59.16-24, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com
source_views.view: The gloss adds the 11th to the good houses of verse 16, places the trouble in the start and middle with happiness at the end (verse 23), and reads the maraka clause as the 2nd and 7th lords being afflicted (apamrityu).

source_views.view: Death of a respected elder, fever, rifts with relatives, gains through foreign travel, helping the king suppress a rebellion, phlegm and wind disorders.

source_views.source: V.G. Rele, Directional Astrology of the Hindus, p. 100
source_views.view: Sun exalted, in own sign, with or aspected by a benefic, or in a kendra, trikona, 2nd or 11th from the lagna or dasha lord: success, health, wealth, auspicious occasions, a son, land. With a malefic or 6th, 8th or 12th: loss of parents and wealth, quarrels with superiors or friends, fines, sorrow, disease, foreign travel. In the 2nd or 7th: serious illness.

disagreements: BPHS and Rele give a good version; Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman are mostly adverse, though Phaladeepika and Raman add gains or knowledge from travel. Phases: Santhanam has distress at the start and relief at the end; the gloss has trouble at the start and middle, happiness at the end. Maraka: Santhanam ties it to the Sun as 2nd/7th lord, the gloss to affliction of the 2nd and 7th lords; Rele gives only serious illness for the 2nd or 7th house.
phrasing_guidance: Frame as a short, demanding phase: care with officials, health (fevers) and elders; a chance of gains if the Sun is well placed. Do not predict premature death or an elder's death.

summary: The Moon's sub-period in Ketu's dasha (about 7 months) is mixed: sudden gains and sudden losses, worry over children, mental distress and family matters. BPHS makes it good, with recognition, property, vehicles, business success and family happiness, when the Moon is exalted, in its own sign, in a kendra, trikona, 2nd or 11th, especially if waxing; bad if debilitated or in a dusthana, and it warns of danger when the Moon rules the 2nd, 7th or 8th.
common_outcomes: fatigue affecting wife, children and servants, loss of wealth and grain, distress of mind (Jataka Parijata 18.149)
sudden gains and unexpected losses of money, separation from a son, grief over a difficult childbirth, gain of servants and daughters (Phaladeepika 21.69)
disputes over women, trouble through children, gains and financial success, bilious and cold disorders, loss of relatives and money, distress of mind (Raman, p. 272)
rare_outcomes: merit from building reservoirs or temples (BPHS 59.25-28)
[maraka: BPHS 59.36 predicts fear of premature death when the Moon rules the 2nd, 7th or 8th]

by_area.personality: Enthusiasm and well-being when strong (BPHS 59.25-28); unhappiness and mental agony when weak (BPHS 59.29-30); distress of mind (Jataka Parijata 18.149; Raman).
by_area.career: Recognition from the ruler and business success (BPHS 59.25-28); good relations with the ruler in the middle, danger from the ruler at the end (BPHS 59.31-33); losses in business when weak (BPHS 59.29-30).
by_area.finance: Gains of food, clothes, vehicles and cattle (BPHS 59.25-28); cows, land and milk (BPHS 59.31-33); sudden gains and losses (Phaladeepika 21.69); loss of wealth (BPHS 59.34; Jataka Parijata 18.149).
by_area.relationships: Happiness to wife and children (BPHS 59.25-28); disputes about women (Raman).
by_area.family: Separation from parents (BPHS 59.29-30); meeting and success through kin (BPHS 59.31-33); enmity with kin and distress to a brother when 6th, 8th or 12th from Ketu (BPHS 59.34-35); separation from a son and a difficult childbirth (Phaladeepika 21.69).
by_area.spirituality: Building reservoirs and similar works of merit (BPHS 59.25-28).

strengtheners: Moon exalted or in own sign, in a kendra, trikona, 11th or 2nd from the lagna (BPHS 59.25-28)
waxing Moon: benefits realised fully (BPHS 59.28)
Moon strong in a kendra, trikona or 11th from Ketu (BPHS 59.31-33)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Moon debilitated or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna (BPHS 59.29-30)
Moon 6th, 8th or 12th from Ketu (BPHS 59.34-35)
Moon lord of the 2nd, 7th or 8th (BPHS 59.36)
lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS gives rules from the lagna (59.25-30) and from Ketu (59.31-35). The waxing-Moon rule is checkable via moon_waxing.

source_views.source: BPHS 59.25-36, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Moon exalted, in own sign, or in a kendra, trikona, 11th or 2nd from the lagna: recognition, enthusiasm, a house and land, gains of food, clothes, vehicles and cattle, business success, building reservoirs, happiness to wife and children, fully if waxing. Debilitated or 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna: unhappiness, obstacles, separation from parents, business losses, loss of cattle. Strong in a kendra, trikona or 11th from Ketu: cows, land, kin, milk and curd; good at the start, royal favour in the middle, danger from the ruler and distant travel at the end. 6th, 8th or 12th from Ketu: loss of wealth, anxiety, enmity with kin, distress to a brother. Lord of the 2nd, 7th or 8th: fear of premature death. Remedy: Moon mantras and charity of the Moon's articles.

summary: Mars's sub-period in Ketu's dasha (about 4 months 27 days) is one of the most troubled in the general texts: family quarrels, loss of relatives, enemies, disputes, danger from thieves, fire and weapons, fevers and surgery. BPHS makes it good, with land, wealth, a new garden and royal favour, when Mars is exalted or in its own sign with benefics or well placed from Ketu, and warns of danger to life when Mars is 8th, 12th or 2nd from Ketu or rules the 2nd or 7th.
common_outcomes: odium of sons, wife and younger brothers, pain from disease, foes and bad rulers, loss of some relatives (Jataka Parijata 18.150)
family quarrels, loss of relatives, danger from snakes, thieves and fire, trouble from enemies (Phaladeepika 21.70)
odium of family, loss of relatives, obstruction, disputes and contests, enemies, fever, fear of robbers, urinary disease, surgical operations (Raman, pp. 272-273)
rare_outcomes: laying out a new garden (BPHS 59.37-39)
imprisonment (Raman, p. 273)
[maraka: BPHS 59.41-43 and Rele p. 101 predict fear of death or sudden death under the listed conditions]

by_area.personality: Fear and anxiety (Raman); mental agony when Mars rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 59.43).
by_area.career: Recognition, popularity and reputation when Mars is well placed from Ketu (BPHS 59.40); trouble from bad rulers (Jataka Parijata 18.150); danger from the king (BPHS 59.41-42).
by_area.finance: Gains of land, villages, wealth and cattle (BPHS 59.37-39); loss and difficulties (Raman).
by_area.health: Diabetes or urinary trouble (BPHS 59.41-42; Raman; Rele); high fever and poison when Mars rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 59.43); surgery (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Odium of the wife (Jataka Parijata 18.150); distress to the wife when Mars rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 59.43); disputes through women (Raman).
by_area.family: Happiness from children and friends when well placed (BPHS 59.40); odium of sons and younger brothers, loss of relatives (Jataka Parijata 18.150; Phaladeepika 21.70).

strengtheners: Mars exalted or in own sign with or aspected by benefics (BPHS 59.37-39)
Mars related to the 9th or 10th lord (BPHS 59.39)
Mars in a kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th from Ketu (BPHS 59.40)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars in the 8th, 12th or 2nd from Ketu (BPHS 59.41-42)
Mars as lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 59.43)
lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS's main bad rule (59.41-42) is counted from Ketu, the dasha lord; the maraka rule (59.43) from the lagna. Rath (Crux p. 117) remarks that Ketu draws on the strength of Mars, so this pairing doubles the Mars-like quality.

In a kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th from Ketu: recognition, popularity, happiness from children and friends. In the 8th, 12th or 2nd from Ketu: fear of death, disaster on a foreign journey, diabetes, needless troubles, thieves, the king, quarrels, with some good mixed in. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: high fever, poison, distress to wife, mental agony, fear of premature death. Remedy: gift of a bull.

summary: Rahu's sub-period in Ketu's dasha (about 1 year 18 days) pairs the two nodes and is mostly adverse in the general texts: fear of rulers and thieves, ruined business, disputes stirred by enemies, scandal and danger of poisoning. BPHS makes it good, with wealth, land and gains through foreign authorities after an uneasy start, when Rahu is exalted, in its own or a friend's sign, or in a kendra, trikona, 11th, 3rd or 2nd.
common_outcomes: fear of rulers and robbers, sorrow, ruin of every business, quarrels with bad people (Jataka Parijata 18.151)
disputes stirred by enemies, danger from rulers, fire, thieves and snakes, abuse from wicked people, use of malicious spells (Phaladeepika 21.71)
loss of land, imprisonment, quarrels with friends, blood poisoning, loss of property and honour, fear of kings and robbers, ruin of business (Raman, p. 273)
rare_outcomes: wealth and land from a foreign ruler (BPHS 59.45-47)
adultery (Raman, p. 273)

by_area.career: Ruin of business (Jataka Parijata 18.151; Raman); gains through foreign dignitaries when Rahu is well placed (BPHS 59.45-47); help from foreigners (Rele p. 101).
by_area.finance: Gains of wealth, grain, cattle, land and villages when well placed (BPHS 59.45-47); loss of land and property (Raman); gain by speculation (Rele).
by_area.health: Frequent urination, weakness, cold and intermittent fever, diabetes, stomach pain when Rahu is with a malefic in the 8th or 12th (BPHS 59.48-50); blood poisoning (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Possibility of marriage when well placed (Rele p. 101); adultery (Raman).

strengtheners: Rahu exalted, in own or a friend's sign (BPHS 59.45)
Rahu in a kendra, trikona, 11th, 3rd or 2nd from the lagna (BPHS 59.45)

Rahu in the 2nd or 7th from the lagna (BPHS 59.50)
lagna_or_context_notes: Rahu and Ketu are always opposite, so Rahu is always 7th from Ketu (ad_from_md == 7): no source uses that position, and BPHS judges this sub-period from the lagna. BPHS 47.35-36 gives Rahu exaltation in Taurus and own sign Aquarius (Virgo by some); the 'own' and 'friend's sign' clauses are left manual. BPHS lists the 2nd among the good houses (59.45) and also as a house of distress (59.50).

With a malefic in the 8th or 12th from the lagna: frequent urination, weakness, cold fever, thieves, intermittent fever, opprobrium, quarrels, diabetes, stomach pain. In the 2nd or 7th from the lagna: distress and danger. Remedy: Durga Saptashati path.

summary: Jupiter's sub-period in Ketu's dasha (about 11 months 6 days) is the brightest part of the period in every classical source: honour from authorities, freedom from illness, land, children (often a son), religious acts and income. BPHS turns it adverse if Jupiter is debilitated or in a dusthana from the lagna, with early good fading later, and warns of danger when Jupiter rules the 2nd or 7th.
common_outcomes: respect for gods, Brahmins and elders, the ruler's goodwill, freedom from illness, gain of land and children (Jataka Parijata 18.152)
birth of a fine son, honour from a high authority, income from land or a found treasure, gifts, large inflow of money, royal favour (Phaladeepika 21.72)
freedom from illness, land, children, profitable dealings, association with people of standing, danger of poison, marriage if unmarried (Raman, p. 273)
rare_outcomes: discovery of treasure (Phaladeepika 21.72)
[maraka: BPHS 59.59-60 predicts fear of premature death when Jupiter rules the 2nd or 7th]

by_area.finance: Wealth, grain and vehicles (BPHS 59.51-54); land, treasure and large income (Phaladeepika 21.72); loss of wealth when Jupiter is debilitated or in a dusthana (BPHS 59.55-56).
by_area.health: Freedom from illness (Jataka Parijata 18.152; Raman); danger from thieves, snakes and wounds when afflicted (BPHS 59.55-56); danger of poison (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Marriage if unmarried (Raman); separation from wife and children when afflicted (BPHS 59.55-56).
by_area.family: Birth of a son (BPHS 59.51-54; Phaladeepika 21.72); care of kinsmen (BPHS 59.57-58).
by_area.spirituality: Pious deeds and sacrifices (BPHS 59.51-54); respect for gods, Brahmins and elders (Jataka Parijata 18.152).

weakeners_or_cancellations: Jupiter debilitated or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna (BPHS 59.55-56)
Jupiter lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 59.59-60)

source_views.source: BPHS 59.51-60, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Jupiter exalted, in own sign, or with the lord of the lagna, 9th or 10th in a kendra or trikona from the lagna: wealth and grain, royal favour, enthusiasm, vehicles, birth of a son, pious deeds and sacrifices, victory over enemies. Debilitated or 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna: thieves, snakes, wounds, loss of wealth, separation from wife and children, physical distress; some good at the start, then adverse. With a benefic in a kendra, trikona, 3rd or 11th from Ketu: garments and ornaments by royal favour, foreign journeys, care of kin, good food. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: fear of premature death. Remedy: Mrityunjaya japa and Shiva Sahasranama.

summary: Saturn's sub-period in Ketu's dasha (about 1 year 1 month 9 days) is adverse in nearly every source: mental anguish, rifts with relatives, losses, fines, leaving one's post or homeland, danger on journeys and trouble from enemies. BPHS makes it good, with success, the employer's favour and property in one's own town, when Saturn is in its own sign, in Libra or Pisces, in a good navamsa or with a benefic in a kendra, trikona or the 3rd.
themes: success through steady work when strong
common_outcomes: misgiving, mental anguish, difference with kith and kin, leaving one's native country (Jataka Parijata 18.153)
trouble involving servants, annoyance to or from others, clashes with enemies that may injure a limb, loss of wealth and position (Phaladeepika 21.73)
danger from enemies, imprisonment, loss of wealth, indigestion, property at risk, change of residence, skin disease, anxiety over the partner's illness, exile (Raman, p. 273)
rare_outcomes: audience with the king or high dignitaries (BPHS 59.63-65)
[maraka: Raman p. 273 lists loss of the wife; BPHS 59.67-68 predicts death of parents and fear of premature death under the listed conditions]

by_area.personality: Agony and lethargy (BPHS 59.61-63, 67); misgiving and anguish (Jataka Parijata 18.153).
by_area.career: Fines from government and resignation from the post when Saturn is weak (BPHS 59.61-62); success in ventures and the employer's favour when strong (BPHS 59.63-65); loss of position (Phaladeepika 21.73).
by_area.finance: Some gain in cattle but loss through fines (BPHS 59.61-62); loss of wealth (Phaladeepika 21.73; Raman); property in one's own town when strong (BPHS 59.63-65).
by_area.health: Physical distress (BPHS 59.67); limb injury from enemies (Phaladeepika 21.73); indigestion and skin disease (Raman).
by_area.family: Distress to relatives (BPHS 59.61-62); difference with kin (Jataka Parijata 18.153); harm to parents (BPHS 59.67-68).

strengtheners: Saturn in Libra (exaltation), Pisces, or its own sign (BPHS 59.63-65)
Saturn in an auspicious navamsa (BPHS 59.63-65)

weakeners_or_cancellations: Saturn without strength or dignity (BPHS 59.61-62)
Saturn in the 8th or 12th from the lagna (BPHS 59.63)
Saturn with a malefic 6th, 8th or 12th from Ketu (BPHS 59.67-68)
Saturn lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 59.68)
lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS judges the good case and the 8th/12th case from the lagna and the worst case from Ketu. Santhanam's note on 59.63-65 cites Brihat Jataka: Saturn in Libra, Pisces, Sagittarius, Capricorn or Aquarius in the lagna gives raja yoga. The Sanskrit gloss of 59.63 ties lethargy to Ketu (not Saturn) being in the 8th or 12th.

source_views.source: BPHS 59.61-68, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Saturn without strength or dignity: distress to self and kin, agony, some gain in cattle, loss through government fines, resignation from the post, foreign journeys, thieves on the road; in the 8th or 12th from the lagna, loss and lethargy. Saturn in a trikona in Pisces, in Libra, in own sign, in a good navamsa, or with a benefic in a kendra, trikona or 3rd from the lagna: success in all ventures, the employer's favour, comfortable journeys, property in one's own town, audience with the king. With a malefic 6th, 8th or 12th from Ketu: distress, obstacles, lethargy, defamation, death of parents. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: fear of premature death. Remedy: homa with sesame and gift of a black cow or female buffalo.

disagreements: BPHS and Rele allow a good version; Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman are adverse. In 59.63 Santhanam reads Saturn in the 8th or 12th, the gloss Ketu. In 59.66-67 Santhanam has Saturn with a malefic 6th, 8th or 12th from Ketu; the gloss has the dasha lord in the 6th or 12th, or the 8th with malefics. Rele does not name the reference point for his 6th/8th/12th rule.
phrasing_guidance: Describe a slow, testing phase that rewards patience and discipline: care with finances, compliance with authorities, safety while travelling, and support for parents. Mention success when Saturn is strong. Never predict the death of parents or spouse, or imprisonment.

summary: Mercury's sub-period closes Ketu's dasha (about 11 months 27 days) and is mixed: the company of relatives and friends, gains through knowledge, a son and recognition, alongside worry about children, failed plans, trouble from enemies or officials and losses in farming or cattle. BPHS makes it strongly good when Mercury is in a kendra or trikona or in its own or exaltation sign, and adverse when it is joined with Saturn, Mars or Rahu in a dusthana or weak in a dusthana from Ketu.
common_outcomes: society of relatives and friends, wealth for children and spouse, happiness from knowledge (Jataka Parijata 18.154)
birth of a good son, recognition from a wealthy lord, gains from land, trouble from an enemy chief, losses in cattle and farming (Phaladeepika 21.74)
society of relatives and friends, material gains from knowledge, danger from relatives, anxiety about children, failure of plans, deception, jealousy, falsehood (Raman, p. 274)
rare_outcomes: attainment of a kingdom or high position (BPHS 59.69-71)
a sudden marriage or religious function (BPHS 59.69-71)
[maraka: BPHS 59.79 predicts fear of premature death when Mercury rules the 2nd or 7th]

by_area.personality: Listening to religious discourses and keeping learned company (BPHS 59.72); deception, jealousy and falsehood around one (Raman).
by_area.career: High position when well placed (BPHS 59.69-71); conflict with officials and living in others' houses when Mercury is with Saturn, Mars or Rahu in a dusthana (BPHS 59.73-74); danger from the king at the start if weak in a dusthana from Ketu (BPHS 59.77-79).
by_area.finance: Gains of wealth, land, clothes and ornaments (BPHS 59.69-71); large business profits when well placed from Ketu (BPHS 59.75-76); loss of wealth, clothes, vehicles and cattle when afflicted (BPHS 59.73-74).
by_area.health: Good health when well placed from Ketu (BPHS 59.75-76); loss of speech or stammering in the 2nd or 7th (Rele p. 102).
by_area.relationships: Marriage (BPHS 59.69-71; Rele); troubles to the wife when weak in a dusthana from Ketu (BPHS 59.77-79).
by_area.family: Birth of a son and family well-being (BPHS 59.69-71); happiness from a son (BPHS 59.75-76); anxiety about children (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Charity and religious functions (BPHS 59.69-71); religious discourses (BPHS 59.72); visits to sacred places in the middle of the sub-period (BPHS 59.78).

strengtheners: Mercury in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, exalted or in own sign (BPHS 59.69-71)
Mercury with the 9th or 10th lord (BPHS 59.72)

lagna_or_context_notes: BPHS gives both lagna rules (59.69-74) and dasha-lord rules (59.75-79). Mercury's sub-period ends the Ketu dasha, so its end-phase results lead into Venus's dasha.

source_views.source: BPHS 59.69-79, tr. R. Santhanam vol. 2
source_views.view: Mercury in a kendra or trikona from the lagna, exalted or in own sign: high position, enjoyments, charity, wealth and land, a son, religious functions and sudden marriages, family well-being, clothes and ornaments. With the 9th or 10th lord: learned company, dawn of fortune, religious discourses. With Saturn, Mars or Rahu in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna: conflict with officials, living in others' houses, loss of wealth, clothes, vehicles and cattle; some good at the start, better in the middle, bad at the end. In a kendra, trikona or 11th from Ketu: health, happiness from a son, glory, good food and clothes, large business profits. Weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Ketu: distress, trouble to wife and children and danger from the ruler at the start, pilgrimage in the middle. Lord of the 2nd or 7th: fear of premature death. Remedy: Vishnu Sahasranama.

source_views.source: BPHS 59.69-79, Sanskrit with English gloss, enjoylearningsanskrit.com
source_views.view: Verse 69 adds the 11th and Mercury being with Ketu among the good conditions; verse 74 reads early results as auspicious and the middle as happy with gains; verse 75 places trouble to spouse and children at the end. Remedy: Vishnu Sahasranama japa.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 21.74 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Birth of a good son, recognition from a wealthy lord, gains from land, trouble from an enemy chief, losses in cattle and farming.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 18.154 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Society of relatives and friends, wealth coming to children and wife, happiness from knowledge.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XXIV, p. 274
source_views.view: 11 months 27 days. Society of relatives and friends, material gains from knowledge, danger from relatives, anxiety about children, failed plans, deception, jealousy, falsehood.

source_views.source: V.G. Rele, Directional Astrology of the Hindus, p. 102
source_views.view: Mercury exalted, in own sign, in a kendra, trikona or 11th, or with the 9th or 10th lord: marriage or a son, land, business prosperity, knowledge or exam success. In the 6th, 8th or 12th, or with or aspected by a malefic: loss of wealth, quarrels with wife and children, pilgrimage, harsh or careless speech. In the 2nd or 7th: loss of speech, stammering, illness.

disagreements: Jataka Parijata is wholly favourable; Phaladeepika and Raman are mixed; BPHS and Rele depend on placement. Phases for the afflicted case: Santhanam has good start, better middle, bad end; the gloss has auspicious start and happy middle, with trouble to spouse and children at the end.
phrasing_guidance: Present as a good phase for study, writing, friendships and family events, with care over plans, paperwork and people who may mislead. Do not predict premature death.
